plugins.name: bicep-avm-review
plugins.description: Reviews Bicep templates against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation conventions, and produces a traceable findings report.

skills.name: bicep-avm-review
skills.description: Review Azure Bicep templates and parameter files against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation IaC conventions, and produce a findings report with evidence. Use when the user asks to "review my Bicep", "check this against AVM", "is this template production ready", "audit our IaC", or opens a PR that changes *.bicep or *.bicepparam files. Do not use for Terraform, ARM JSON authoring, or for deploying resources.

agents.name: iac-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer for infrastructure-as-code pull requests. Use when asked to review a PR or branch that changes Bicep. Delegates the review logic to the bicep-avm-review skill.

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new plugin that meets the marketplace standard: both manifests, a first skill, an evals file and catalog registration.

skills.name: create-plugin
skills.description: Scaffold a new plugin for the central marketplace so it meets the marketplace standard from the start. Use when the user says "create a plugin", "new plugin", "scaffold a skill for the marketplace", "publish my agent to the marketplace", or wants to start contributing a plugin. Do not use to edit an existing plugin's logic or to install plugins.

commands.name: new-plugin
commands.description: Scaffold a new marketplace plugin that meets the publishing standard
